title: Bi-modal Richards component attribution
question: Are the strict bottom-flux failures controlled by retention/capacity approximation or by conductivity approximation?
variants: selected lookup theta/C + selected lookup K
selected lookup theta/C + exact analytical K
exact analytical theta/C + selected lookup K
decision_rule: Attribute the failed observable to a component only when restoring that component analytically closes the frozen bottom-flux gate without changing the nonlinear path. If both matter, record mixed attribution.
